request: Build a small Jac web app that recommends items. Users like items; for a user, the app recommends items liked by similar users (users who share at least one liked item), ranked by how many similar users liked each item. A user can hide an item so it is never recommended to them again.
acceptance: If u1 and u2 both liked i1 and u2 also liked i2, u1's top recommendation is i2.
A user with no likes gets the most-liked items overall, ties broken by item id ascending.
Hidden items and items the user already liked never appear in the recommendations, even when they would score highest.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Model the entities as nodes and the relations as edges; traverse them with walkers or graph queries.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
